notes:
Quick CRM notes & call quotes:
- Customer: SaaS KB for mid-enterprise customers (support portals + internal docs).
- Primary goal: fast, cheap search for high QPS customer support flows; also internal agent assist.
- Indexing: currently ~3.2M chunks (~1.1B tokens). Incremental daily ingestion ~25k chunks/day.
- Desired latency: 95th pct <200ms for retrieval + rerank (end-to-end), p50 <80ms.
- Cost target: <= $0.01/query for average support query (including embedding call + ANN + light rerank).
- Architecture preference: hosted API (want fast time-to-market); open to dedicated later if costs blow up.
- Retrieval: hybrid dense (HNSW) + BM25 prefilter, then top-100 cross-encoder rerank. POC uses top-k 100/200.
- POC notes: seeing good quality w/ Open models but cross-encoder rerank increases CPU/time; exploring Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and model mix.
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable economics. If we hit 200 qps sustained we need hard per-query SLA and fallback rules."
- Additional asks: rate-limited burst handling, prefix caching for repeated queries, per-tenant isolation (multi-tenant data partitioning).
- SE feedback: can likely meet latency at 150 qps with model caching + KV cache; need to validate cost envelope.
- Procurement concern: procurement wants clear estimate for 12-month committed capacity (dedicated option) vs hosted OPEX.
- Next major milestone: final POC report + cost projection due 2026-03-25.
technical_summary: POC config: hosted_api endpoints for embed + retrieve; ~3.2M dense vectors (1536 dim) stored in HNSW ANN layer. Sparse BM25 prefilter reduces ANN calls by 4x on average. Cross-encoder rerank runs on CPU for top-100 candidates; POC testing included a smaller quantized reranker for latency comparisons. Observed metrics: sustained qps 120-140, peak 260 (1 minute bursts), median retrieval latency 45ms (ANN), cross-encoder 90-180ms depending on batch. Cost baseline (hosted): $0.012/query; target negotiated <$0.01 with batching/Optimize recommendations.
qps_targets: sustained 150 qps, peak 300 qps, p95 end-to-end <200ms
